content: दमः [दम् भावे घञ्] .²1 Taming, subduing. .²2 Self-command, subduing or curbing the passions, self-restraint; <ls>Mb. 1. 100. 2</ls>; <ls>Bg. 10. 4</ls>; (निग्रहो बाह्यवृत्तीनां दम इत्यभिधीयते). .²3 Drawing the mind away from evil deeds or curbing its evil propensities; (कुत्सितात्कर्मणो विप्र यच्च चित्तनिवारणं स कीर्तितो दमः). .²4 Firmness of mind, .²5 Punishment, fine; चिकित्सकानां सर्वेषां मिथ्या प्रचरतां दमः <ls>Ms. 9. 284</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">290</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 293</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 4</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 18. 41</ls>. .²6 Mire, mud. .²7 Viṣṇu. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a brother of Damayantī.
दमः, -मम् <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 A house, home; दमेदमे समिधम् <ls>Vāj. 8. 24</ls>. .²2 The inmates of a house.
